p: Arabians to the camp had slain: Meaning the Philistines.
Forty and two years old was: Read 2Ch 21:20.
one year in Jerusalem: That is, after the death of his father.
of Omri: She was Ahab's daughter, who was the son of Omri.
counsellors after the death of his: He shows that it follows that the rulers are as their counsellors are and that there cannot be a good king who allows wicked counsellors.
was of God by coming to: By this we see that nothing can come to any but by God's providence and as he has appointed, and therefore he causes everything to serve his purposes.

Jehoshaphat: This was the just plague of God because he joined himself with God's enemies: yet God to declare the worthiness of Jehoshaphat his grandfather moved them to give him the honour of burial.
destroyed all the seed royal of: So that there would be no one to claim the crown and so she might usurp the government.
house of God six years: Meaning, in the chamber where the priests and Levites slept, who kept their courses weekly in the temple.
